coordinates: PDF points, origin top-left, y grows downward. Underscore run or drawn rule: its x extent, from 14 pt above the line to 1.5 pt under it. Cell or box: its drawn edges. Tick box: the printed square. Picture pages: the picture's pixels through the page's drawing matrix.

signing.kind: Subscription agreement for common shares of a closed-end company: the owner (and a second owner for joint accounts) completes sections 1-6, initials each representation on pages 3-4 and signs on page 5; a custodian signs for custodial accounts; the financial adviser and a principal of the broker-dealer complete and sign section 8. No issuer acceptance block.
